title: Chapter 17 Everyone Has His Own Duties
content:
Chapter 17 Everyone Has His Own Duties

In front of Lu Daosheng.

The remaining people are not as powerful as Huang Shou.

In fact, these people were in extreme despair when they met Lu Daosheng.

There are old people who are about to die of life, beggars who almost starve to death on the street, and even soldiers who are about to die of battle.

Without exception, these people were all given new life by Lu Daosheng.

So these people are very loyal to Lu Daosheng.

“I want to build my own army.”

Lu Daosheng looked at everyone in front of him and directly expressed his thoughts.

If you want to build the deserted city into a supreme force, you must have the power you have.

Having a strong army is a good condition.

Hearing this, a man with a general's appearance stood up.

His ancient aura was particularly powerful, but after just experiencing the terrifying pressure of the unknown realm of Huang Shou, everyone didn't feel much.

Above the Emperor of Heaven, there is the Tao realm, and above the Tao realm, there is the ancient realm, and above the ancient realm, there is unknown.

"City Lord, build an army, I can share your worries with you."

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled with satisfaction. He was waiting for this sentence, otherwise why would you take in?

He remembered that this general-looking man was encountered in a deserted galaxy. At that time, the galaxy was already dilapidated, and dense corpses almost pounced on the entire void.

The general man stood dying on the ruins, looking at the sky with his eyes dazed.

The country was destroyed and the family was destroyed. Everyone died, and he was the only one who survived.

He was seriously injured at that time and was already dying. In the end, Lu Daosheng rescued him and gave him a new life.

Since then, the general man has completely served Lu Daosheng.

"Then it's a labor."

Lu Daosheng smiled slightly and took out a ring, which stored a large amount of resources, enough to build an invincible army.

After taking the ring, the man looked at it, and his eyelids twitched.

This is certainly a building of an army, not a star fleet?

Taking a deep breath, the man knelt on one knee and whispered loudly: "Please rest assured, the city lord, I will live up to the city lord's expectations!"

Immediately, the man turned around and left.

Looking at the man's departure back, Lu Daosheng vaguely remembered that his name was Yunqi.

After countless years, this name will become a terrifying existence and will be called the God of Killing by the world.

Wherever you go, no grass grows.

"Sir, what about us?"

A man from the quasi-emperor realm looked at Lu Daosheng with anticipation.

Others have received their own positions, so they can't watch it.

Now who doesn't want to work for Lu Dao? They didn't see the opportunity given, the divine sword and sword, and the massive resources, which made them feel itchy.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng looked at the quasi-emperor man.

After thinking for a while, he thought of his identity.

A wanderer wandering in the land of nothingness, he has no worries.

But when Lu Daosheng met by chance, Lu Daosheng naturally saw the potential of this man.

The body has the legendary body of nothingness and can freely travel through the land of nothingness. Once the body is perfect, it can even open up a land of nothingness with bare hands. In the land of nothingness, the body of nothingness is an invincible existence.

Of course, unless he is as strong as Lu Daosheng, he can break the entire land of nothingness with bare hands, it is almost impossible to defeat him.

So, Lu Daosheng brought him back.

The condition given by Lu Daosheng was to awaken the body of nothingness for him.

"An Xing, do you want to live in the darkness?"

Lu Daosheng looked at An Xing and said slowly.

Upon hearing this, An Xing was stunned for a moment, then nodded resolutely and said, "For the sake of the city lord, what is this sacrifice?"

Anyway, I have been wandering in the land of nothingness all year round, and I am a person in the darkness. Living in the darkness is already accustomed to it.

Hearing this, everyone around him gave a thumbs up in praise.

We are a role model.

Lu Daosheng also nodded with satisfaction.

The next moment, a strange thing that was dark and terrifyingly black flew into An Xing's hands.

"Take this thing, your body of nothingness will be awakened. When you reach the Emperor of Heaven, the body of nothingness will be greatly improved."

Looking at the black object in his hand, An Xing looked happy.

"Thank you, Lord, thank you."

Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Okay, next, I hope you can form a force from the Undead City and kill all dangers in the cradle."

Then Lu Daosheng handed An Xing a ring, which also contained unimaginable resources.

After taking the ring, An Xing immediately took a breath of cold air, and his expression of looking at Lu Daosheng became more and more respectful.

"Mr. Lord, what should the name of this force be chosen?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng pondered for a moment and slowly said, "Just call me, root."

"Root?"

"Well, it's the root."

"Oh, okay, Lord, the villain will be formed now."

Then An Xing turned into a black shadow and disappeared from the spot.

Since this day, the name An Xing has completely become the secret of the deserted city. It is not known to the top figures. People in the world only know that the leader comes from the land of nothingness, and is an existence where the dragon sees its head but not its tail.

And if you say a bad word about the root leader, your head will fall to the ground in the next second.

......

After an unknown amount of time, Lu Daosheng slowly walked out of the void.

All the recruited people were arranged to their suitable positions, which can be regarded as making the best use of them.

Looking at the deserted city below, it is still the same as it was a month ago, but it has been three hundred years.

Well, the population has actually increased. It seems that the citizens of this city are not always practicing.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng's figure appeared in the sight of everyone in the deserted city.

Seeing Lu Daosheng.

Everyone in the deserted city stopped what they were doing and saluted Lu Daosheng respectfully.

"City Lord! You are finally back!"

Below, a slightly younger old man hurriedly said excitedly.

Seeing this old man, Lu Daosheng raised his eyebrows slightly.

"Old Li, you finally fulfilled your wish and broke through to the state of concentration."

Hearing this, the old man Li blushed.

In fact, he has already reached the realm of saints, far beyond the realm of concentration.

What Lu Daosheng said was just about what happened three hundred years ago.

At that time, old man Li said that he would definitely break through to the realm of concentration.

When they heard Lu Daosheng's words, everyone burst into laughter.

"City Lord, we are all rough people, and we don't know what to say. Anyway, if there is trouble in the future, we will be the first to stand up."

"Yes, Lao Zhang is right, we will be the first to stand up."

Once, saints were legendary existences, and even the realm of life and harmony was a realm they dared not even think about, but now, they are at least saints.

All of this is given by their great city lord, Lu Daosheng.

Looking at the promises of dozens of people below, Lu Daosheng smiled with relief.

Once, it was a small deserted city, and they were closely united to deal with all difficulties together.

And now, the deserted city has become bigger, but they are still extremely united.

This is the deserted city, his Lu Daosheng's deserted city.

"In that case, I, Lu Daosheng, would like to thank you all first."

Lu Daosheng said with a smile.

"By the way, I will open the barrier of this deserted city soon. When the time comes, many people will enter the city. You should be careful not to sell your own houses no matter how much someone pays. Do more business."

Hearing this, everyone said, "We will remember it."

Hearing the reply, Lu Daosheng nodded and then disappeared from everyone's sight.
